title.zh: 论文原图 / 三个阶段，闭合一轮探索
title.en: Original figure / Three stages close an exploration loop

alt.zh: Dream-RSI 原图 1：真实探索、构造重放模拟器、离线探索策略改进，更新后的策略再进入下一轮真实探索。
alt.en: Dream-RSI original figure 1: online exploration, replay simulation and offline policy improvement, followed by redeployment.

caption.zh: Dream-RSI 项目图 1。小回路比较候选策略，大回路引入新的真实实验结果；底层编码 Agent 不因这个机制而自动变成新模型。
caption.en: Dream-RSI project figure 1. The inner loop compares policies; the outer loop adds new real outcomes. The mechanism does not itself replace the coding model.

title.zh: 论文原图 / 两个模型，各自比较调用与留出任务时间
title.en: Original plot / Calls and held-out runtime for each model

alt.zh: Dream-RSI 的 Lasso 发现轨迹图，横轴为累计发现调用，纵轴为六个留出任务平均运行时间，比较固定探索与 Dream-RSI。
alt.en: Dream-RSI Lasso trajectories: cumulative discovery calls versus average runtime on six held-out tasks, comparing fixed exploration and Dream-RSI.

caption.zh: 项目图 3 的发现轨迹。数字表示递归轮次；横轴不是所有模型费用，纵轴不是整个研究的墙钟时间。本刊未复测。
caption.en: Project figure 3 discovery trajectories. Numbers denote recursive rounds. The axes are neither the full model bill nor research wall-clock time. We did not rerun this study.

title.en: Original diagram / Responsibilities inside a PANDA node

alt.zh: PANDA 论文图 1：团队通信与集体通信分开，注册信息、组队重规划、Agent 后端和基础设施故障检测连接在一起。
alt.en: PANDA figure 1: separate team and collective communication, linked to registries, team management, agent backend and infrastructure failure detection.

caption.zh: 从 PANDA 论文第 3 页截取完整图 1。图中的组件是一个节点内部的职责，并非五个独立 LLM，也不是整个集体的集中控制台。
caption.en: Complete figure 1 from page 3 of PANDA. These are responsibilities within a node, not five independent LLMs or a collective-wide control center.
